svg.aria-label: I’m Chanelle, 30, a student at the University of Tasmania, an AI enthusiast and a freelance researcher. I started on GitHub in July 2026 and got my first merge in October. A few months ago I never would have believed I could code, and now I can’t stop. I’m better at finding the thing nobody built than at waiting for someone to build it. That snake down there is on a diet. I’m working on it.
